_note: D2 metric rules (development_plan 5.2). Both read a value the indexer already measured (entity.lines / entity.param_count) and are L1 only where the threshold is a hard limit; a preference stays L2. Thresholds are the tool's built-in defaults until M2 reads declared constraints from .codescope/profile.yaml.

rules.name: function_too_long
rules.description: Function body exceeds the 120-line hard limit (code_rules 1.1, 9). Measurement, not a heuristic: entity.lines is recorded by the indexer.

rules.name: too_many_parameters
rules.description: More than 5 parameters: an options struct is usually clearer (code_rules 9). Observation only - the threshold is a style preference, not a proven defect.
